name: Circular Fallacy
storyline: You awake in an unknown, surreal space with no memory of how you arrived. As the world around you warps through interwoven layers of time and space, your quest becomes clear: uncover your true identity. Guided by “cards” and your separated senses (Hand to interact, Eye to observe, Think to analyze), you must piece together the fragmented narrative and choose paths that shape multiple possible endings.
summary: Circular Fallacy is a narrative-driven puzzle adventure blending 2D card mechanics with immersive 3D environments. Players switch between a card table interface and first-person scenes, using a unique dice-check system to unlock branching paths and solve multi-solution puzzles. Every choice leads to different outcomes, weaving a surreal and emotionally layered story about identity, memory, and reality.
